name: First Principles Thinking
id_mapping: ENGINEERING_ADAPTATION: FW numeric correspondence to AG; source explicitly illustrates FW-11

source_original.purpose: Dekonstruksi asumsi industri hingga ke kebenaran fundamental fisika/ekonomi lalu merekonstruksi solusi
source_original.inputs: Masalah biaya/inovasi dan daftar asumsi konvensional saat ini
source_original.outputs: Daftar asumsi yang dipatahkan, aksioma dasar, dan arsitektur solusi baru

purpose: Separate observations, constraints and conventional assumptions
activation_conditions: User requests First Principles Thinking or the orchestrator justifies it against the problem.
methodology: Separate observations, constraints and conventional assumptions
Challenge each assumption using evidence and underlying physical or economic constraints
Reconstruct candidate solutions from supported fundamentals
Compare feasibility and identify tests for remaining assumptions
tool_requirements: Host reasoning and resource reading; calculation tool when required.
evidence_requirements: Cite material claims; mark missing inputs UNKNOWN; do not reuse illustrative source conclusions.
limitations: Host-authored analysis requires behavioral evaluation; schema validity does not prove truth.
validation_criteria: Provide assumption_ledger or declare it UNKNOWN with reason.
Provide fundamentals or declare it UNKNOWN with reason.
Provide reconstructed_options or declare it UNKNOWN with reason.
Use all distinctive methodology steps and identify missing evidence.
